enchantments.tooltip: Arcane Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower sorcerer or wizard spells by two.
Divine Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower Divine spells by two.

Alchemical Conservation: This item modifies the user's energy expenditure in such a way that many abilities can be used more frequently than normal. You will gain +1 ki on every successful attack, and you will increase the number of Action Boosts, Turn Undead attempts, and Bard Songs you can use per rest by 1 each.These additional uses will only take effect after you rest.
Use Magic Device +5: Passive: +5 Competence bonus to the Use Magic Device skill.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
